أعلولي (form XII)
# أَعْلَوْلِي (ʔaʕlawlī) /ʔaʕ.law.liː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# أَعْلَوْلِيَ (ʔaʕlawliya) /ʔaʕ.law.li.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
